critical_findings.complementary_role_characterized: Dense embeddings (multilingual-e5 center_projected) EXCEL at two specific capabilities TF-IDF cannot provide: (1) Citation Heritage Recovery at scale (AUC 0.79-0.85 vs TF-IDF 0.71-0.74), minimal sufficient scale ~130k decisions (21yr, requires recent-year citation pair density); (2) Section Cross-lingual Alignment hierarchy Sachverhalt (facts, gap=0.187) > Dispositiv (holding, gap=0.397) > Erwaegungen (reasoning, gap=0.452), center projection improves all sections 16-38%. Linear hybrids PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ (122k) with optimal w=0.3-0.4 (30-40% dense), adding cross-lingual recall (0.124→0.160) but REMAINING BELOW TF-IDF jurist preference baseline (JP 0.66-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). Two-mode tradeoff FUNDAMENTAL: no single representation dominates LangDom+JP+CiteIndep at any scale. True OOS JP ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_minimal_scale: 21-year (137k decisions, 100 positive pairs): raw AUC 0.8455, cp64 AUC 0.8182. 22-year (144k, 344 pairs): raw AUC 0.7946, cp64 AUC 0.7922. Capability emerges when sufficient cross-year citation pairs exist (years 2019+). Center projection preserves capability with better similarity gap (0.410 vs raw 0.063).
critical_findings.section_crosslingual_hierarchy: Sachverhalt (facts) SUPERIOR cross-lingual alignment: cp_64 cross_lang_same_branch=0.282, invariance_gap=0.187, separation=+0.032. Dispositiv (holding) INTERMEDIATE: 0.150, 0.397, -0.152. Erwaegungen (reasoning) POOREST: 0.094, 0.452, -0.265. Center projection reduces gaps: Sachverhalt 38%, Dispositiv 31%, Erwaegungen 16%. Full corpus evaluation BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k scale.
critical_findings.linear_hybrid_optimal_weight: 19-year (122k): optimal w=0.3 for both cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.6465) and hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.6365). 22-year (144k): optimal w=0.4 for cited_decisions_tfidf (JP=0.6725), w=0.3 for hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.6605). Scale shifts optimal weight toward denser semantic contribution. Hybrids PASS both adversarial gates but JP remains 0.11-0.12 below TF-IDF baseline.
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_fundamental: TF-IDF citation hybrids: LangDom~0.48, JP~0.78, CiteIndep~14%. Semantic (center_projected): LangDom~0.83-0.98, JP~0.05-0.43, CiteIndep~37%. Linear Hybrids: LangDom~0.58-0.80, JP~0.61-0.67, CiteIndep~25-35%. NO single representation dominates all three metrics at any scale (3yr-22yr).
